reports.title: (In thousands of Brazilian reais, except for earnings per share information)

desk.headline: Revenue up 6% to R$985m, just below estimates; profit up 7%; no guidance, Yduqs merger pending
results: Revenue grew 6.1% to R$985.2m, slightly short of the analysts' R$994m estimate.
Operating income rose 9.9% to R$304.8m as credit-loss charges and other expenses fell, even though gross margin slipped to 62.8%.
Net income rose 7.2% to R$171.0m; diluted EPS was R$1.88 against R$1.70.
Over nine months the undergraduate (medical school) segment grew revenue 7.4% while continuing education was flat and medical practice solutions barely moved.
Year to date Afya declared R$307.4m of dividends (R$129.8m a year ago) and bought back R$140.3m of its own shares.

guidance.summary: The filing gives no outlook. Afya agreed on 23 Sep 2026 to merge into Brazil's Yduqs, with Afya holders to own 69% of the combined group; the deal needs shareholder and antitrust approval.

watch: Shareholder and antitrust approvals for the Yduqs merger (deadline 31 Mar 2028).
Whether continuing education and medical practice solutions return to growth.
Debt: loans and financing rose to R$2.12bn from R$2.05bn at December.
